cards.title: A Royal Welcome
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [DWARVEN] companion to heal a [DWARVEN] ally. Skirmish: Exert a [DWARVEN] ally to add that ally's strength or damage bonuses to an unbound [DWARVEN] companion (limit once per phase). Regroup: Exert a [DWARVEN] ally to heal a [DWARVEN] companion.
cards.lore: “‘There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'”

cards.title: Song of Durin
cards.gameText: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. \The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +1.\Fellowship: Discard this condition to hinder a Shadow condition (or discard up to 2 [moria] conditions).
cards.lore: “No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....”

cards.title: Arwen
cards.subtitle: Elven Rider
cards.gameText: Ranger. Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard X cards from hand to prevent that wound, where X is the current region number.
cards.lore: “‘If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'”

cards.title: Arwen
cards.subtitle: Lady Undomiel
cards.gameText: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -1 for each home 3 [ELVEN] ally you can spot (limit -4).
cards.lore: “Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.”

cards.title: Elrond
cards.subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad
cards.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 to heal that ally up to 2 times. Add (1) per wound healed. Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
cards.lore: “Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....”

cards.title: Erestor
cards.subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
cards.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] or [ringwraith] card, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “‘Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'”

cards.title: Galadriel
cards.subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
cards.gameText: At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another Elf. Each time the fellowship is about to move to an opponent's site during the Fellowship phase, you may exert Galadriel to replace that site with a forest of the same site number from your adventure deck.
cards.lore: “‘There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'”

cards.title: Golradir
cards.subtitle: Councilor of Imladris
cards.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an Orc).
cards.lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.

cards.title: Phial of Galadriel
cards.gameText: To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Bearer's resistance is +2.
cards.lore: “‘May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'”

cards.title: Saelbeth
cards.subtitle: Elven Councilor
cards.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.
Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an\Uruk-hai).
cards.lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.

cards.title: Vilya
cards.gameText:
Bearer must be Elrond.
Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice to hinder a Shadow condition.
cards.lore: “Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.”

cards.title: Deep in Thought
cards.gameText: Spell.\Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard a Shadow condition and hinder all other Shadow conditions.
cards.lore: “He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....”

cards.title: Aragorn
cards.subtitle: Heir to the White City
cards.gameText: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (1).
cards.lore: “‘...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'”

cards.title: Gondor Bowmen
cards.gameText: Tale. Archery: Exert a [GONDOR] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
cards.lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.

cards.title: Horn of Boromir
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and discard this possession to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
cards.lore: “On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....”

cards.title: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a companion or ally. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish against an [ISENGARD] minion, add a burden. At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may exert bearer twice to discard this condition.

cards.title: Hate and Anger
cards.gameText: Spot an Uruk-hai and an Orc to draw 3 cards.
cards.lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.

cards.title: Hollowing of Isengard
cards.gameText: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [ISENGARD] card from hand to add (3) (or (5) if that card was an Orc).
cards.lore: “‘Rip them all down!'”

cards.title: Orthanc Berserker
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 4 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
cards.lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.

cards.title: The Palantir of Orthanc
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area.\Shadow: Exert an [isengard] minion.  The Free Peoples player may place any number of cards from hand on top of their draw deck, then reveals their hand.  For each Free Peoples card revealed, make that minion strength +1 until the regroup phase.  Limit once per phase.
cards.lore: “‘Seven stars and seven stones....'”

cards.title: Saruman
cards.subtitle: Keeper of Isengard
cards.gameText: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Maneuver: Exert Saruman to make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase. Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, discard (or exert) Saruman to prevent that wound.

cards.title: Servants to Saruman
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an [ISENGARD] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if that Orc is strength 7 or less).
cards.lore: “‘This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'”

cards.title: Trapped and Alone
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each character skirmishing an [ISENGARD] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons. Skirmish: Spot a skirmishing [ISENGARD] Orc. Make the Free Peoples shuffle another [ISENGARD] Orc into your draw deck to cancel the active skirmish.
cards.lore: “‘...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'”

cards.title: Uruk Raider
cards.gameText: Tracker. \While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and damage +1.\Each time an ally exerts, you may spot another [isengard] card and exert this minion to wound that ally.
cards.lore: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.

cards.title: Malice
cards.gameText: Spot a [MORIA] Orc and a [SAURON] Orc to play up to 2 [SAURON] or [MORIA] items from your discard pile. Wound a Free Peoples archer for each item played.
cards.lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.

cards.title: Such a Little Thing
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer and a [MORIA] minion, discard a possession borne by bearer. The Free Peoples player may exert bearer or discard another Free Peoples item to prevent that.
cards.lore: “‘Boromir... give the Ring to Frodo.'”

cards.title: News of Mordor
cards.gameText: Choose one: exert an [ISENGARD] minion to make a Nazgul damage +1 until the regroup phase, or exert a Nazgul to make an [ISENGARD] minion unable to take wounds until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'”

cards.title: Too Great and Terrible
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [ringwraith] minion. Bearer must\be a companion or ally (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer.\Each time bearer is exerted by a Free Peoples card, exert bearer unless the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand of bearer's culture.
cards.lore: “His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. ‘Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'”

cards.title: The Dark Lord Advances
cards.gameText: Exert a [SAURON] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. You may take a minion into hand from your draw deck costing up to X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed. The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘A power was there that we have not felt before.'”

cards.title: Get Off the Road!
cards.gameText: Search. Spot a [SAURON] card and a Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each burden you can spot. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'”

cards.title: Hand of Sauron
cards.gameText: Exert a unique [SAURON] minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer) and discard a possession attached to that companion. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from their hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘The power of the Ring could not be undone.'”

cards.title: His Cruelty and Malice
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Discard a [SAURON] minion to reveal the top 2 cards of your opponent's draw deck. If at least 1 is a Free Peoples card, exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Your opponent may discard all revealed Free Peoples cards to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'”

cards.title: Massing in the East
cards.gameText: To play, discard a [SAURON] minion. Return up to X [SAURON] minions to hand, where X is the number of races you can spot in the fellowship. The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘The power of the Black Land grows....'”

cards.title: Terrible as the Dawn
cards.gameText: If a companion or ally's special ability is used, you may spot a [SAURON] card to wound that character. The Free Peoples player may discard another companion to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'”

cards.title: Tower of Barad-dûr
cards.gameText: To play, exert a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves, draw 2 cards. The Free Peoples player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....”

cards.title: Bill the Pony
cards.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be Sam. Each site's Shadow number is -1. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
cards.lore: “‘That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'”

cards.title: Frying Pan
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘I think I'm getting the hang of this!'”

cards.title: The Shire Countryside
cards.gameText: To play, spot 2 [SHIRE] companions. Plays to your support area. Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal up to 2 companions (limit once per phase).
cards.lore: “‘Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'”

cards.title: Wastes of Emyn Muil
cards.gameText: Shadow: Heal a companion to play an [ISENGARD] Orc from your discard pile.
